library(DBI)
library(odbc)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
start_date <- as.Date(params$start_date)
end_date <- as.Date(params$end_date)
snapshot_date <- as.Date(params$snapshot_date)
stopifnot(
  !is.na(start_date),
  !is.na(end_date),
  !is.na(snapshot_date),
  start_date <= end_date
)
pct_difference <- function(registered, ons) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(ons) | ons == 0,
    NA_real_,
    100 * (registered - ons) / ons
  )
}
comparison_bar <- function(data, category, title, subtitle, y_title = NULL) {
  category_quo <- rlang::enquo(category)
  ggplot(
    data,
    aes(
      x = Pct_Difference,
      y = !!category_quo,
      fill = Pct_Difference
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Pct_Difference)),
      hjust = ifelse(data$Pct_Difference >= 0, -0.12, 1.12),
      size = 3.7
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.16, 0.18))
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#B2182B",
      mid = "#F2F2F2",
      high = "#2166AC",
      midpoint = 0,
      guide = "none"
